text.title: Barracks Heart
text.declared_genre: Indietronica / Dub Electronica / Ambient Chamber Bass
text.declared_key: G minor lifting toward B-flat major without full release
text.declared_mood: Armored tenderness -> grateful ache -> complicated inheritance
text.production_notes: Deep dub bass with slow marching pulse, muted guitar plucks, brushed rim in a distant drill pattern, trumpet-like synth pad, lighter click tucked low, reverb held tight around the verses then stretched on "barracks heart", final hook opens with stacked but fragile harmonies
text.vocal_notes: Close, intimate androgynous lead, warmer than the first two tracks; restrained verses, widened hook; low octave doubles under the father images; small group hum arrives after the bridge like distant formation
section_names: Intro - distant step pulse | low brass pad
Hook - fuller low end | warm but unresolved
Final Hook - group hum | slow lift
Outro - low brass fades | lighter click
